name: Ancient Rivener

source.title: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star

notes.languages: can speak and understand only simple words

items.name: Violent Instincts
items.text: An ancient rivener attacks the nearest creature when Confused instead of any other effect, and ignores magical commands compelling them to do anything other than attack.

items.name: Slaughter Tackle
items.text: The ancient rivener Leaps at a target within 30 feet, and then makes one jaws Strike and one claw Strike in any order.

items.name: Squirt Blood
items.text:
Frequency once per day

---

Effect The ancient rivener squirts blood from one of their eyes at a target within 30 feet. The target must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude save save or become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

text:
Ikeshtis who eschew their society are exiled and quickly devolve into violent creatures known as riveners.

---

Ikeshtis are reptilian humanoids native to Akiton's wastelands. Smaller than Golarion's iruxi, ikeshtis organize around distinct societal roles.
